author: agent
sentences: When I started my channel, I made five mistakes I still think about.
First, I bought gear before I had a single script.
Second, I posted whenever I felt like it.
Fourth, I copied formats that did not suit me.
Fifth, I never looked at what people actually watched.
My watch time per video was 40 seconds, and fixing those pushed it up to 3 minutes.
